# SkyBlue_0 never matched in 8 states. Let me check if the cycle is longer.
# Continue cycling SkyBlue_0

top_patterns_dict = {
    0: "BBBBB\nB...B\nBB.BB\nB...B\nB...B",
    1: "BBBB.\nB..BB\nB...B\nBB..B\n.BBBB",
    2: "B...B\nBBBBB\n..B..\nBBBBB\nB...B",
    3: "BBBB.\nB..B.\nB..BB\nB..B.\nBBBB.",
    4: "....B\n..B.B\nBBBBB\n..B.B\n....B",
    5: "BBBBB\nB..B.\nB..B.\nBBBB.\nB....",
    6: "..B..\nBBBBB\nB.B.B\nB.B.B\n..B..",
    7: "..BBB\n..B.B\nBBBBB\nB.B..\nBBB..",
    8: "....B\n..B.B\nBBBBB\nB.B..\nB....",
    9: "BBBBB\nB...B\nB.BBB\nB.B.B\nBBBBB",
    10: "BB.BB\nB...B\nB...B\nBBBBB\nB...B",
    11: "..B..\nBBBBB\nB.B.B\nBBBBB\n..B..",
}

def get_pattern(r, c):
    ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    pat = ""
    for dr in range(1, 6):
        row_str = ""
        for dc in range(1, 6):
            ch = ascii_lines[r + dr][c + dc]
            row_str += "B" if ch == "B" else "."
        pat += row_str + "\n"
    return pat.strip()

def find_match(pat):
    for idx, tpat in top_patterns_dict.items():
        if pat == tpat:
            return idx
    return -1

# Continue cycling SkyBlue_0 for more states (already did 8, now do 16 more)
print("=== SkyBlue_0 continued cycle ===")
for i in range(16):
    action(['UP'])
    pat = get_pattern(40, 14)
    m = find_match(pat)
    match_str = f"Cell {m}" if m >= 0 else "NONE"
    print(f"  State {8+i}: {match_str}")

# Check if all patterns are unique or if there's a cycle
# Also check the current pattern
pat = get_pattern(40, 14)
print(f"\nCurrent SkyBlue_0 pattern:\n{pat}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
